# Partiful — account brief

## Who
Partiful is a party invite and event planning product, described on its homepage as "Partiful — Delightful, free party invites. Plan events and parties with friends." ([source](https://partiful.com/)). Its GitHub org profile lists partiful.com ([source](https://github.com/partiful)).

## Production Expo signals
- `eas.json` is present in `partiful/mobile` ([source](https://github.com/partiful/mobile/blob/main/eas.json)).
- A second `eas.json` is present in `partiful-app/mobile-legacy` ([source](https://github.com/partiful-app/mobile-legacy/blob/main/eas.json)).
- `package.json` in `partiful/mobile` pins react-native 0.74.5 ([source](https://github.com/partiful/mobile/blob/main/package.json)).
- The repo has CI workflows under `.github/workflows` ([source](https://github.com/partiful/mobile/tree/main/.github/workflows)).
- An open issue reads "eas update rollout stuck at 0% for Android channel" ([source](https://github.com/partiful/mobile/issues/61)).
- The org has 12 public repos and 180 followers ([source](https://github.com/partiful)).
- The App Store listing shows 41,200 ratings ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/partiful/id1590736570)).

## Who to talk to
- Maintainer One (@partiful-maintainer-1), top contributor to `partiful/mobile` with 142 commits; profile lists company "Partiful" and website https://partiful.com ([source](https://github.com/partiful-maintainer-1)).
- Maintainer Two (@partiful-maintainer-2), 87 commits to `partiful/mobile`; profile lists company "Partiful" and website https://partiful.com ([source](https://github.com/partiful-maintainer-2)).
- Maintainer Three (@partiful-maintainer-3), 31 commits to `partiful/mobile`; profile lists company "Partiful" and website https://partiful.com ([source](https://github.com/partiful-maintainer-3)).

## Why now
`partiful/mobile` last pushed on 2026-08-14 ([source](https://github.com/partiful/mobile)), and the App Store listing shows 6 releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/partiful/id1590736570)). The app is on react-native 0.74.5 ([source](https://github.com/partiful/mobile/blob/main/package.json)).

## Suggested opener
Maintainer One, you have 142 commits in `partiful/mobile` ([source](https://github.com/partiful-maintainer-1)). I saw the open issue "eas update rollout stuck at 0% for Android channel" ([source](https://github.com/partiful/mobile/issues/61)), alongside 6 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/partiful/id1590736570)). When an Android rollout stalls at 0%, what do you currently do to get that update out to users?
